title: tshark/strato: Make common code for profile handling
description:
Create a new file to handle "common" terminal application functionality to (start) reducing the common code between tshark and strato.  Having profile functionality be the start because all that is done for it is dumping out the list of current profiles

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: Is cli_common file how we want to start "sharing" common code between tshark and strato (and tfshark in the future)?
